name: River Friends Day Camp
description_short: Day camp for children ages 2 to 6 at the Shames JCC on the Hudson in Tarrytown, with swim lessons, sports, gardening and cooking, water play, yoga, music, dance and crafts. Twos come for a morning or afternoon half day; threes have half and full days and 4 to 6 year olds come 9 to 3.
swim_waterfront_notes: Upper Camp (4 to 6) has daily free swim and instructional swim lessons by age group.
notes: 2027 non-member totals for 2 to 8 weeks (minimum 2 weeks; the first two must be consecutive): 2s morning $1,610 to $5,280; 2s afternoon $1,550 to $5,040; 3s half day $1,980 to $6,440; 4s, 5s and 6s full day $2,270 to $6,960. Members with a JCC family membership pay less (for example $1,410 to $4,680 for 2s mornings and $2,070 to $6,360 full day). Deposit $1 if registered by November 30, 2026, then $500, applied to tuition; balance in thirds March 1, April 1 and May 1, 2027. Twos must be 2 by their start date.
